# util

[![Build Status](https://example.invalid/defunctzombie/node-util.png?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/defunctzombie/node-util)

node.js [util](http://example.invalid/api/util.html) module as a module

## install via [npm](example.invalid)

```shell
npm install util
```

## browser support

This module also works in modern browsers. If you need legacy browser support you will need to polyfill ES5 features.
